description: This file contains unit tests for utility functions related to credits calculations, environment variable handling, and data normalization for a costs modal. It tests functions from './credits' and includes mock data and assertions to verify expected behaviors.

methods.name: getCreditsPerUsd
methods.description: Returns the current conversion rate from USD to credits, defaulting to 20000 if the environment variable is not set.

methods.name: usdToCredits
methods.description: Converts a USD amount to credits based on the current credits-per-USD rate, handling string inputs and invalid values.
